thread:
Ava L.: Quick sync: ran sequoia-14b v1 fp16 vs int6 on the socratic-assist slice. Big perf win, some quality hotspots. Summary below.
Jon M.: drop the numbers please.
Ava L.: slice=socratic-assist-400 (avg 1100 tokens). fp16 Rouge-L=46.3 / BERTScore=0.904. int6 Rouge-L=44.0 / BERTScore=0.892. p95 latency fp16=980ms -> int6=560ms. throughput +2.2x. cost/1k tokens fp16=$0.082, int6=$0.048.
Priya T.: hallucination/failure modes? Which intents are sensitive?
Ava L.: auto-eval n=1200: int6 mean Rouge-L drop 2.3 pts (sd 1.1). Hallucination flagged 18/1200 (1.5%) vs fp16 4/1200 (0.33%). Failures concentrate on deep multi-step Socratic chains and "policy-clarify" intents where omitted premise leads to misleading conclusions. Not wholesale fabrications but subtle context loss.
Felix R.: Product: For "policy-clarify" and "compliance-guidance" we need <0.5% hallucination. 1.5% is too high unless we gate by intent.
Ava L.: Econ quickcalc: baseline tokens/month ~210M. Routing 30% to int6 yields raw infra savings ~ $22.0k/mo for that portion -> overall site savings ~$6.6k/mo net after estimated escalation costs (~$3.1k/mo at current rates). Rough numbers.
Jon M.: Can we segment by intent + runtime confidence + an edge heuristic (thread_depth, presence_of_numbers)? Provide a routing proto pls.
Ava L.: Proposed routing proto (draft):
```yaml
route: socratic-assist
rules:
  - if intent in [policy-clarify, compliance-guidance, legal_review] then model: sequoia-14b-fp16
  - elif model_confidence < 0.64 then model: sequoia-14b-fp16
  - elif thread_turns > 9 or last_user_tokens > 400 then model: sequoia-14b-fp16
  - else model: sequoia-14b-int6
fallback: sequoia-14b-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate_by_intent, cost_delta
```
Priya T.: Suggest adding a cheap syntactic heuristic: if user asks for "step by step" or contains enumerations, prefer fp16. Also add 1% fp16 holdback for drift detection and a 48h human QA sweep during ramp.
Felix R.: Also require compliance signoff before opening int6 for any policy intents.
eval-bot: Auto-eval on recent live sample=300 -> int6 mean Rouge-L drop=2.1 (sd 0.9). hallucination flagged 5/300; manual triage confirmed 4/300 (1.33%). Heuristic "contains_enumeration" would have caught 2/4 confirmed.
Ava L.: Canary plan: 48h 5% non-sensitive -> if stable ramp to 30% over 10 days with 1% fp16 holdback. Rollback triggers: hallucination_rate > 1% for sensitive intents over 6h OR rouge_l drop > 2.0 sustained 12h.
Jon M.: I'll add dashboard panels (rouge-trend, hallucination by intent, classifier_false_neg, cost_delta). Set alert for rollback triggers.
Priya T.: I'll prepare GTN README + reproducible eval notebook + per-intent cost sheet. Link will be posted.
Felix R.: Good plan. If the edge heuristic plus a small discriminator reduces false negatives by >=50% we can consider increasing int6 allocation to 45% later. Compliance signoff required either way.
Ava L.: Launching canary now. Will post interim auto-eval snapshots here. :rocket:
